summary: MDJM LTD filed a Form 6-K reporting that on May 14, 2026, the Nasdaq Hearings Panel denied the Company's request to reinstate its listing and determined to delist its Class A ordinary shares. The delisting follows a prior staff determination due to the closing bid price being $0.10 or less for 10 consecutive business days. Trading was suspended March 20, 2026. No terms or advisors are named. The delisting is effective. Watch for OTC trading or potential shareholder actions.
